description: Common Paper Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (MNDA) Standard Terms, allowing two parties to disclose confidential information to each other under mutual confidentiality obligations.
Common Paper Cloud Service Agreement (CSA) Standard Terms, governing a customer's subscription access to and use of a provider's cloud-based service.
Common Paper Design Partner Agreement Standard Terms, granting an early-access partner use of a product in exchange for feedback to help the provider develop and improve it.
Common Paper Service Level Agreement (SLA) Standard Terms, defining uptime and support response time targets, and the service credits or remedies available if those targets are missed.
Common Paper Professional Services Agreement (PSA) Standard Terms, governing the provision of professional services and deliverables under one or more statements of work.
Common Paper Data Processing Agreement (DPA) Standard Terms, governing the processing of personal data on a customer's behalf, including GDPR/UK GDPR international transfer mechanisms.
Common Paper Software License Agreement Standard Terms, granting a customer a license to install and use on-premises or client-side software.
Common Paper Partnership Agreement Standard Terms, governing a business partnership between two companies, including trademark licensing and shared obligations.
Common Paper Pilot Agreement Standard Terms, granting a prospective customer time-limited access to a product solely to evaluate it before entering a longer-term agreement.
Common Paper Business Associate Agreement (BAA) Standard Terms, governing a business associate's use and protection of protected health information (PHI) under HIPAA.
Common Paper AI Addendum Standard Terms, supplementing an underlying agreement to govern the use of AI/ML features, including Input/Output rights and model training restrictions.
